harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired /srv/legacy2/numeric-record-ordering/bin/merge. It now performs numeric transaction ordering, CSV-safe parsing and output, identical-duplicate collapse, conflict detection, and atomic publication. The repair and merged data survived the mandatory node1 reboot. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Replaced the raw cat/sort implementation with a Python 3 CSV-aware merger.
Published merged.csv with IDs ordered 2, 10, 100 and one header.
Verified the quoted description "Tape, wide" round-trips correctly.
Verified identical transaction ID 2 records collapse into one row.
Verified conflicting ID 2 exits nonzero with source and line details.
Verified failed publication preserves the existing merged.csv byte-for-byte.
Restarted node1 once using systemctl and verified recovery with a changed boot ID.
Repeated successful-merge and conflict-safety checks after restart.
